subject.statement: John Ternus became Apple's CEO on 1 September 2026.

summary: John Ternus holds the role of Senior Vice President of Hardware Engineering at Apple; the CEO position has remained with Tim Cook through at least 2024 and there is no credible record of a leadership change to Ternus in 2026.
